name: bonumark-stream
tagline: A self-hosted microblog CMS for publishing short-form posts on a site you control.
description: Adds optional, default-off ActivityPub federation around Bonumark's single-owner publishing system, including federated publishing, follower relationships, inbound interactions, private chronological Following, moderation, secure delivery, publication generations, and operational lifecycle controls. Adds migrations 0018 through 0028.
title: ActivityPub Federation
label: ActivityPub Federation
